title: Power model and reproducible experiment v1
description: Units are explicit; references, dimensions, positivity, aligned times and numerical feasibility are validated by the Power compiler. Synthetic input must not be treated as calibrated evidence.

gas.description: Fixed-volume gas nodes require storage. A moving gas chamber omits storage and must be owned by exactly one gas_cylinder component; the compiler validates this topology.

valve_timing.description: Sin-squared opening versus crank angle. Cycle must be 360 or 720 degrees; duration must be at least 1e-6 radians and no greater than the cycle. Initial input and input channel set the peak opening in [0,1]. The compiler validates normalized bounds.

mass_fractions.description: Fuel and fresh-air mass fractions must sum to at most one. The remainder is inert products; compilation checks the sum.

converter_map.description: Explicit signed map spanning [-1,1]. Compiler checks ordering, continuous reactions and passivity throughout interpolation. End at ratio 1 with torque ratio 1 and coefficient 0.
